The 2024 Masters Tournament was the 88th time this tournament was played. Scottie Scheffler won the Green Jacket for the second time.
**Winner** : Scottie Scheffler, 277
**Where it was played** : Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia
**Tournament dates** : April 11-14
**Leader after first round** : Bryson DeChambeau, 65
**Leaders after second round** : Max Homa, Bryson DeChambeau and Scottie Scheffler, 138
**Leader after third round** : Scottie Scheffler, 209
## What Happened in the 2024 Masters Tournament
Scottie Scheffler carded a final-round 68 and pulled away over the back nine to win by four-strokes over runner-up Ludvig Aberg in the 2024 Masters. It was the second Masters title for Scheffler, who also won in 2022.
Scheffler played the back nine of the final round in 33 strokes, his only stumble a bogey on No. 11. But he made birdies on the 10th, 13th, 14th and 16th holes.
Scheffler entered the final round leading by one over second-place Collin Morikawa, and by two over third-place Max Homa. But Morikawa scored 74 and Homa 73 to share third place with Tommy Fleetwood, seven shots back of Scheffler.
Tiger Woods set a Masters Tournament record by [making his 24th consecutive cut at Augusta National](https://www.golfcompendium.com/2023/11/masters-consecutive-cuts-made.html). The first year of Woods' streak was 1997, and he had made the cut every year since when playing. He had previously shared the record of 23 consecutive cuts with Gary Player and Fred Couples.
But But Woods scored 82 in the third round, his worst-ever score in The Masters and [the second-worst round of his PGA Tour career](https://www.golfcompendium.com/2022/05/tiger-woods-worst-scores.html) to this point. And after a final-round 77, Woods' 304 total was the highest of his career.
